styles.name: kpi-figure

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Line height 1.55 throughout; headings tighten tracking by 0.01em.

styles.usage: Section headings (h2) in a section head, followed by a muted tag and a rule.

styles.name: lead-text
styles.usage: The hero lead in on-hero-lead: clamp(15px, 1.7vw, 19px), max 60ch.
